title: Highlight karakter over-limit per blok batch ditolak / Over-limit character highlight per rejected batch block
summary: ID: Rincian blok ditolak menampilkan full text tiap blok dengan karakter di atas max_prompt_length ditandai merah. / EN: Rejected-block details show each block's full text with characters above max_prompt_length marked red.
problem_before: ID: Pengguna bertanya apakah karakter >500 bisa ditandai warna berbeda; <textarea> tak bisa rich-text sehingga highlight inline tak mungkin. / EN: A user asked whether >500 characters could be marked in a different color; <textarea> cannot do rich text so inline highlight was impossible.
solution: ID: Opsi C — daftar rincian di bawah preview hanya untuk blok ditolak: text.slice(0, maxPromptLen) normal + text.slice(maxPromptLen) dalam span merah (konvensi BatchHistory); ambang ikut config (default 500), bukan hardcode; key i18n overflowHeading id/en. / EN: Option C — a details list below the preview for rejected blocks only: text.slice(0, maxPromptLen) normal plus text.slice(maxPromptLen) in a red span (BatchHistory convention); threshold follows config (default 500), not hardcoded; overflowHeading i18n key in id/en.
reason: ID: Fokus diagnosis tanpa me-render 50 item; blok pendek ditolak tetap tampil tanpa span merah. / EN: Focused diagnosis without rendering 50 items; short rejected blocks still render with no red span.
user_impact: ID: Kelebihan karakter terlihat merah per blok; ringkasan rejectedBlocks inline tetap ada. / EN: Excess characters appear red per block; the inline rejectedBlocks summary remains.
tech_impact: ID: Perubahan render BatchForm saja; snippet 50 blok ekstrem bisa panjang (diterima untuk V1). / EN: BatchForm render change only; extreme 50-block snippets can be long (accepted for V1).
